title: Create helper class
summary: Generates a Byte-family record helper for an enum type represented by a Structure-tree node
intro: Read this when you have an enum and want the usual conversion helpers without writing them by hand. Right-click the enum in the Structure form and choose Create helper class to generate a Byte-family record helper with ToByte, FromByte, ToInteger, FromInteger, ToString and FromString.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint create-enum-helper --qname <TEnum> [--apply|--json|--no-backup] [--methods <csv>] [--tostring rtti|case] [--db PATH] - generate a Byte-family record helper for an enum
